question: Where will the Maha Kumbh 2021 be organized?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haridwar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kumbh Mela 2021 was organized at Haridwar, Uttarakhand.**
 
• Kumbh Mela 2021 was held for only **30 days, from April 1 to 30** this year in view of the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• The** term "kumbh" comes from the Sanskrit word kumbha, which means "pitcher".**
 
• **It is also the Sanskrit name for Aquarius**, the zodiac sign in which Jupiter resides during the Haridwar mela. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kumbh Mela**__

 
 
• **Kumbh Mela is a religious festival that is celebrated four times over the course of 12 years**, the site of the observance rotating between four pilgrimage places on four sacred rivers at Haridwar on the Ganges River, at Ujjain on the Shipra, at Nashik on the Godavari, and at Prayagraj.
 
• The festival is traditionally credited to the **8th century** Hindu Philosopher and saint Adi Shankara.
 
• It is considered the **"World's largest congregation of religious pilgrims".**
 
• It has been inscribed on the** UNESCO'sRepresentative **List of Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.
 
• The Kumbh Mela authorities said that the largest one-day attendance at the Kumbh Mela was 30 million on 10 February 2013.
